title: Meditation Metric1 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: Mood entries (`mood:entry`), meditation sessions (`meditation:session`), journal entries (`journal:entry`), gratitude logs (`gratitude:log`).
app: Mood, mindfulness and journaling apps — Daylio / How We Feel mood exports, Headspace / Insight Timer meditation logs, journaling and gratitude entries — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=meditation:metric1
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day meditation metric1 (1) events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on meditation metric1 (1) events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It lays out what time of day your meditation metric1 (1) feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
